description:
Wire the harness into CI on a schedule, not per-PR. Chaos runs are slow and their failures need triage, so gating every PR on them would train people to ignore them.

- Nightly workflow running the suite behind BEDROCK_CHAOS=1 with a fixed duration and a rotating seed.
- On failure, upload the diagnosis bundle (journals, telemetry, per-node traces) as a build artifact -- a chaos failure with no artifacts is unactionable by the time anyone looks.
- Report the seed prominently so a failure can be reproduced locally with one command.

Note bedrock-1qh: the MinIO test fixture binds a fixed port 9000, so parallel or concurrent runs collide. Either resolve that first or serialize chaos runs.

Existing CI is a single ubuntu-24.04 runner matrixed over OTP/Elixir versions; chaos should run on one version only, not the full matrix.
title: Run the chaos suite nightly in CI
